note: Round 4 (November 2026): X advanced search (since:/until:) and Facebook post search filtered by year, run in a logged-in browser. One entry per target date (searched ±1 day); 'unplaced' lists dated posts that mention floods but do not place them in Freetown, so they are kept out of the catalogue.

2013-08-16.note: Philips Street flooding, from a Facebook post dated 18 Aug 2013 that says 'Friday 16 of July 2013'; 16 August 2013 was the Friday (see FT-20130816).

2016-09-17.note: Flooding on the night of 18-19 Sep 2016 with four deaths (Office of National Security via Umaru Fofana); see FT-20160919. A 15 Sep 22:34 UTC X post reports heavy rain only.

2008-08-23.note: No X or Facebook posts for the window (X has almost nothing from 2008).

2008-07-27.note: No X or Facebook posts for the window.

2012-07-29.note: No posts for 28-30 Jul 2012. Nearby: deaths in the 4-6 Jul and flash flooding on 9 Jul 2012 (FT-20120705, FT-20120709).

2010-08-22.note: No posts for the window; 2010 Facebook results are about Freetown, Massachusetts.

2017-07-08.note: Rain only: 'Unumbrellable rain showers in Freetown this morning' and a Mountain Cut rain warning, both 10 Jul 2017.

2015-05-18.note: Rain only: 'Huge downpour of rain in Freetown' (17 May 2015 16:49 UTC).

2016-07-27.note: Rain only: 'Raining again today in Freetown' (27 Jul) and 'It is heavily raining in freetown this morning' (28 Jul 2016).

2018-07-22.note: A Facebook post on 22 Jul 2018 says a week of heavy rain in Freetown brought no recorded flooding.

2013-08-25.note: No Freetown posts; 27 Aug 2013 posts on 'Flooding in Sierra Leone' concern farmers and a company, not Freetown.
